# Nutrition Formula Engine

> A formulation calculator for nutrition products — decimal arithmetic, source-provenanced nutrient data, and explicit handling of missing values.

Site: https://formula.significanthobbies.com

## Pages

- `/` — the formula calculator
- `/case-studies/` — worked formulation examples

## Notes for agents

Missing nutrient data is never treated as zero; calculations preserve
source values and provenance. The engine is a local-first prototype.

Maintained by Sarthak Agrawal: https://sarthakagrawal.dev
